notes.title: Patch notes 2.0
notes.content:
Welcome back Agents! Today we are rolling out the long awaited [b]Oculus Touch[/b]  controller patch. Make sure to set your Steam VR floor calibration correctly for your Oculus Touch controllers (and HTC Vive) via SteamVR. We are super grateful for your patience and we hope to see more videos from your adventures!

Below you'll find a list of what we fixed in "SVRVIVE: The Deus Helix":

Stay classy Agents <3

[b] Major:[/b] 
- Full integration and custom visuals for Oculus Touch controllers
- Collision fixes and water interaction overhaul added to mission 4
- Collision fix when interacting with the broken window in mission 2

[b] Minor:[/b] 
- Increased flashlight area, you should be able to see more at once
- Improved sound cue when completing puzzles stages in mission 3
- Fixed an ambient sound that would leak into mission 1 after loading
- Added visuals and voice lines to the tutorial, matching Oculus Touch
- Prevented mission 3 dlc ice flickering when aiming teleports far away

[b] Our next game "Kartong - Death by Cardboard!" is coming soon so keep your eyes open at www.svrvive.com [/b]

notes.title: Patch notes 1.9
notes.content:
Long time no see Agents! We’ve got a major fix for you... *drumroll* mission THREE will NOT load for a lifetime before you can play it anymore! Thank you for your patience, and sorry if we were a little slow for this update - We're working on Oculus support (SteamVR).

AND let’s just say that we’ve been busy working on a top secret... classified... hush hush... something something... Completely new game! 

As usual, thanks for your feedback and support, means the world to us! <3

Major:

- Loading time for mission 3 significantly decreased.

Minor:

- Replaced secret note texture on present in mission 1 (Xmas dlc).
- Fixed bug where ambience occasionally disappears in mission 3.
- Fixed bug that caused one of the cannons to open door without it pointing towards it in mission 4.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.8
notes.content:
Welcome to patch 1.8 Agents! We’ve noticed that our Christmas DLC has caused the loading time for mission 3 to be a bit… exaggerated. We’ll look into this problem as soon a possible, but it should be a little shorter with this new patch at least. Anyways, additional updates are:

Minor:

- Added interaction with trigger button in menu.
- Fixed so that candle lights can be lit by other candle lights in mission 1.
- Fixed bug with ambience sounds being out of place and to low in mission 2.
- Fixed bug with river in mission 2, causing it to glitch.
- Improved door in mission 2 to open when close by.
- Decreased mission 3 loading time a little bit (we are looking into the problem).
- Fixed problem with players using teleportation shortcuts in mission 4.
- Fixed bug with cannon causing players to skip part of one puzzle in mission 4.
- Fixed bug on monocular that caused it to glitch inside other objects in mission 4.
- Increased elevator speed in mission 5.
- Fixed bug that caused bell to not respawn in mission 5.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.6

Also, we wanted to make sure you get this DLC before Christmas, and we will be making it muuuuch lighter over the next few days.

Fixed sound bug in mission 2.

Fixed unnecessary respawn of some misc items in mission 4.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.1
notes.content:
First patch live! We’ve listened to you, our mailman and our cat… and we just implemented toggle! For those who liked it the way it was, don’t worry. The objects will only toggle interact (i.e. ”lock to your hand”) if you click it once. If you hold the object for more than 0,45 seconds, the object will not toggle, and instead act as it did before. Best of both worlds 

Additional fixes are:

Major fixes:
- Toggle on interaction when fast clicking objects.
- Removed flashlight and integrated light with the controllers instead. Activate controller flashlight by clicking the grip button.
- Overall performance optimization.


Minor fixes:
- Bug causing light in mission 4 to lose interaction.
- Added an additional graphical quality setting.
- Puzzle fixes in mission 2.
- Bug causing players to teleport in hidden area in mission 4.
- Replaced teleportation end nodes with meshes instead of lights.
- New loading screens.
- Fixed rotation of in-game menu.
- Fixed broken roof in mission 5.
- Fixed ignore teleport on some objects.
- Fixed bad spawn of object in mission 5.
- Puzzle fixes in mission 4.
- Fixed out of place doors in mission 5.
- Fixed stuck orbs in puzzle in mission 3.

notes.title: Release note from the team
notes.content:
Stockholm, November 17th 2016

Hello Agents! 
We're finally releasing SVRVIVE: The Deus Helix!
We’re so happy to make this game come to life and you Agents have been invaluable for us, your love and feedback keeps us smiling in the office. We will do our very best to keep listening to you, and make sure to use your feedback to keep making things even better.


Earlier during our journey, we announced we would potentially create a new toggle function for object interactions. However, due to the different interaction styles with different objects throughout the game, and a lot of testing, we’ve chosen to keep the hold button interaction style… for now… It simply seems to work better for most people. We will, however, keep experimenting on this and might add multiple toggle options in future updates.


We also want to say this - the release of SVRVIVE: The Deus Helix is only the beginning for our team. So buckle up Agents! ːsteamhappyː

/SVRVIVE Studios

TLDR: We're releasing!

notes.title: DEMO Patch notes 1.2
notes.content:
Hey! Thanks for helping us find the bugs! Your feedback is invaluable as it helps us make a better game. We've listened to your opinions about a toggle function to grab objects, and we'll make sure to include this function in the full release. Thanks Agent ParaPlays and many others. 
Fixes for now are:

-Fixed bug that occasionally made the key fall out from the keyhole
-Fixed missing collider on bookshelf
-Improved lock, so that the whole thing falls to the ground
-Fixed clipping in some event sounds
-Lowered the volume on the drawers
-Fixed ending in room one, that occasionally made objects get stuck

Good luck, Agents!

notes.title: DEMO Patch notes 1.1
notes.content:
Hey folks! Thanks for all the feedback and great ideas for improvements. We love to hear about your experience with the game! Special thanks to Whirlmeister and The Ace Station for sending us some truly stellar feedback.

-Fixed position of floor in the intro
-Fixed snapping to position in hand for some key items
-Fixed transmission messages to only play three times instead of constantly repeating itself
-New transmission message sound
-Fixed drawer textures so it can be affected by flashlight
-Fixed code buttons to not be interactable until you've solved the painting puzzle to avoid cheating
-Improved lock mechanism
